A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] '''customs officer''' was responsible for overseeing [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He accepted a modest bribe of one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from the crew of the ''[[Alabak's Gold]]'', an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] ship.

==Behind the scenes==
This officer is visually similar to the non-[[canon]] character [[Skreen]], the technical director of the [[Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association]] from [[Lusaanda]].
